_om: Engelska texter i appen. Nyckeln är den svenska texten i mall.html, värdet är engelskan. {n} m.fl. byts mot tal eller namn. Saknas en text visas svenskan.
Alla får samma hemliga ord utom impostor: Everyone gets the same secret word except the impostor, who only gets the category. Pass the phone around so each person sees their word.
Everyone puts down their driving licence or ID. One player gets a secret statement and ranks the licences. The others guess which statement it was.
All you need is a deck of cards.

The app is only for people aged 18 or over. Welcome back then!

Blir impostorn utröstad får den en chans: If the impostor is voted out, they get one chance to guess the word. If they guess right, the impostor still wins.
Det var sista kortet. Blanda om för en n: That was the last card. Shuffle for a new deck.

Drick ansvarsfullt. Ni bestämmer själva: Drink responsibly. You decide for yourselves if, when and how much to drink.
Dryckeslexikon innehåller lekar där dric: Dryckeslexikon has games that can involve drinking and is meant for people aged 18 or over. Drink responsibly. Every game works just as well without alcohol.
Du vet inte ordet. Låtsas att du gör det: You don't know the word. Pretend you do and try to work it out.
